errors.text_span: Das Kreisdiagramm enthält eine Legende mit den Bezeichnungen der einzelnen Segmente und Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente.
errors.evidence: The description states that the pie chart contains a legend, but the image does not show any legend.
The description claims that percentage labels are inside the segments, but the image shows the labels outside the chart.
The description does not mention that the numbers corresponding to each category are displayed within the slices in parentheses.
The description does not mention that the slices are not visually emphasized or arranged in a particular order.
